meta.label: Table storage (Oracle, PostgreSQL)
meta.description: Space the table of the dataset takes in its database, by family of objects: table data, indexes, LOB (TOAST on PostgreSQL) and other; storage units, indexes, LOB columns, partitions, tablespaces, compression.

params.name: about
params.description: Tick the metrics to compute: only the total size is ticked by default. Always the whole table, also when computed on one partition of the dataset. A metric the database does not have (compression on PostgreSQL) is left out.

params.name: metric_total_mb
params.label: Total size (MB)
params.description: total_mb: all the table's objects: data, indexes, LOB, other

params.name: metric_table_mb
params.label: Table data size (MB)
params.description: table_mb: the table or its partitions

params.name: metric_index_mb
params.label: Index size (MB)
params.description: index_mb: the table's indexes

params.name: metric_lob_mb
params.label: LOB size (MB)
params.description: lob_mb: Oracle LOB segments and their indexes, PostgreSQL TOAST

params.name: metric_other_mb
params.label: Other size (MB)
params.description: other_mb: Oracle cluster, PostgreSQL sequences of the table's columns

params.name: metric_total_segments
params.label: Storage units
params.description: total_segments: Oracle segments, PostgreSQL relations

params.name: metric_table_segments
params.label: Table data storage units
params.description: table_segments: one per partition holding data

params.name: metric_index_segments
params.label: Index storage units
params.description: index_segments

params.name: metric_lob_segments
params.label: LOB storage units
params.description: lob_segments

params.name: metric_other_segments
params.label: Other storage units
params.description: other_segments

params.name: metric_n_indexes
params.label: Indexes
params.description: n_indexes: indexes of the table

params.name: metric_n_lob_columns
params.label: LOB columns
params.description: n_lob_columns: Oracle LOB columns, PostgreSQL columns that can go out of line (text, bytea, jsonb...)

params.name: metric_partitioned
params.label: Partitioned
params.description: partitioned: YES or NO

params.name: metric_n_partitions
params.label: Partitions
params.description: n_partitions

params.name: metric_n_subpartitions
params.label: Subpartitions
params.description: n_subpartitions

params.name: metric_n_tablespaces
params.label: Tablespaces
params.description: n_tablespaces: tablespaces holding the table's objects

params.name: metric_tablespaces
params.label: Tablespace names
params.description: tablespaces: comma separated

params.name: metric_compression
params.label: Compression (Oracle)
params.description: compression: NONE, BASIC, ADVANCED, QUERY LOW/HIGH, ARCHIVE LOW/HIGH (Exadata HCC)...

params.name: read_connection
params.label: Read through connection
params.description: Optional. Another connection to the same database, e.g. an account with dictionary rights. Empty: the dataset's own connection.

params.name: oracle_dictionary
params.label: Oracle dictionary

selectChoices.label: Automatic: DBA views, else the login user's

params.description: Without SELECT_CATALOG_ROLE, Oracle only shows the sizes of the tables of the login user.
